# Chapter 6 (S051–S060): Steel Watch Foundry to Gortash's roof
## Story so far
- S051: Foundry grounds; Scroll of Knock on the fence gate, Karlach broke the front door. Killed Banites Iron Consul Chadd and Gasper Throaks (Safe Key). Posed as Bane relief crew to Tamia Holzt (Deception, inspiration reroll). Pickpocket for her Security Office Key failed → fight; Tamia, Malik, Bagdog dead, Gondians Frell Olsin and Droo Falbo turned hostile and died.
- S052: Killed Gondian Lowa; got the Security Office Key and Kill Switch Protocol. Zanner Toobin (Security Office) agreed to help destroy the Steel Watch if the Gondian families are freed. Long rest at camp outside the Foundry. Lab entrance fight vs 2 Hellfire Watchers, Marten, Fists, Biggs won; Wyll and Karlach L9. Indora Ralston detonated the Gondians' collars mid-fight (accepted, no reload).
- S053: Lab fights won (Hahns Rives, Yoonce, Zana Hade, Borri Paver); Control Level Key. The Gond book for the Neurocitor codeword was gone. Claude alone, invisible, was spotted at the Neurocitor. Zanner survived the detonation ("get revenge") and follows us. Bought supplies at Beehive General Goods, long rest.
- S054: Titan + 3 Hellfire Watchers: 5 reloads (Karlach in the hellfire, Bulwark, heal retargeted onto the Titan). Plan: range, Elemental Weapon Lightning on Karlach with no other concentration, Shadowheart Command: Halt every turn.
- S055: Titan and Watchers killed, Gontr Mael looted. Zanner saying "Do it" as Claude = Oath Broken (reloaded); Wyll gave the order, Foundry destroyed, Steel Watch disabled. Bhaal cultists in Bloomridge Park (Claude refused, Manip Edenosa sided with us). Elfsong Tavern entered; Map of Murder pickup = theft arrest (reloaded).
- S056: Tusgront's gang alley NE of Heapside Strand: hidden rooftop archers (435 dmg taken). Basilisk Gate route → "Return to Wyrm's Crossing" → drawbridge guards killed clean. Mizora at the north end: Gortash is being ordained, crash the party.
- S057: Mess hall bodyguards near-wiped us (gone after a long rest). Audience Hall (2F): trap grid 40-50 per round; Wyll and Shadowheart died, won.
- S058: Retreat through the Passageway beat the trap grid; both revived after reload.
- S059: Audience Hall cleared; the way to Gortash found (hall N door → Passageway → roof). Attempt 1 vs Gortash: traps 298 dmg in 2 rounds, reloaded.
- S060: Game crashed at start. Attempt 2 (rush) reloaded. Long rest at camp. Attempt 3 with the lure (Claude alone opens the door, Dashes back to the roof corner (15,73,222)): Gortash 192→20, Wyll died, Claude and Karlach downed, not saved. Save S060-pre-gortash.
## Key decisions
- Wyll, not Claude, gives the risky Zanner order (oath rule). No Runepowder bomb. Never enter Orin's temple before Gortash dies.
## Lessons from this chapter
- Shared-turn stall: save+load, or give Wyll a bonus action every turn (see strategy.md).
- Fight outside trap grids (Passageway, roof corner). Gortash is immune to Thunder, Fire, Force; Hold Monster lands.
- Check look_at owner before picking up evidence (theft arrest).
## Loose ends carried forward
- Gortash at 20 HP on retry; then Netherstone, Mizora in camp, Temple of Bhaal (Orin, Gale).
- Elfsong basement (Emperor's Old Hideout), Chef Roveer, Nesha Leesha, Figaro Pennygood, Find Mol, Nightsong (Lorroakan).
